Hello,
I am testing out camtrapR on a small subset of my data. I'm using mp4 videos and have verified that the dateTimeTag is correct (screenshot below). I am using a Mac with digiKam version 8.1.0.

fc03_test <- ("/Volumes/Moore_5TB_2/IRC_Data/FC03_test")

length(list.files(fc03_test, pattern = "MP4", recursive = TRUE))

rec_table1 <- recordTable(inDir  = fc03_test,
                          IDfrom = "metadata",
